ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels (approx. 85%) dominate the central lobe surfaces, sharply delimited by low-intensity black pixels (approx. 15%) concentrated along the trailing edges and lateral margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white regions occupy the central areas of both lobes. Low-intensity black pigmentation is mapped to the entire trailing edge perimeter. Specific localized vertical black linear groupings (stripes) are mapped to the extreme lateral margins of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; visible interior angle estimated at 35 degrees; the lower vertex point is partially occluded by high-intensity water spray/splash pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the posterior boundary; pixel-level amplitude variations (peaks and valleys) occur at regular intervals of approx. 5-15 pixels along the edge contour.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer margins exhibit a smooth convex curve; the trailing edges follow a near-linear trajectory from the distal tips toward the medial notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Cluster of roughly circular low-intensity pixel spots detected on the distal tip of the right lobe, likely corresponding to past epibiont colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of distinct, vertically oriented parallel dark lines are detected on the high-intensity white surface of the outer lateral regions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small brownish-orange low-intensity feature (likely macroalgae or debris) is attached to and trailing from the serrated edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly symmetric 'tiger-stripe' vertical pigmentation pattern present on the distal 10% of both lateral fluke lobes.
